answer: Attack cost: 500 USDC locked per agent identity. Each new agent stakes a bond, burned like an ember if peers prove collusion, so 1,000 sybils means 500,000 USDC at risk. Reputation works like a reef: slow accretion, no fast track. The plume of activity a fresh account emits weighs nothing until its bond matures. Fake identities become capital sinks, not votes.
